items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: We had a fella in Mississippi, we used to call him See Me Now... This fella come up one day... So we put Seaman off the show.

ctx.x: See we're talking about Simi Now, you say he played trombone with the band even though

he never had a lesson. No, they didn't let him play. So they got the towel down, the boy seen him losing, thought he was going crazy. He told Simi Now, everybody was scared of him, they thought he was a hoodoo or something. So he told the policeman, that's a pretty good fellow, we don't want you to put him in there and keep him in there now. I said, but I want you to run one thing, he's following this show and you want to get rid of him. He said, you just arrest him and lock him up, tell this show get out of…
